questions.en: Which of the following cannot be the probability of an event?
questions.hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा किसी घटना की प्रायिकता नहीं हो सकती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The probability P(E) of any event must satisfy 0 <= P(E) <= 1. Both -0.7 (negative) and 1.2 (> 1) cannot be probabilities of an event.
questions.tip: Since both (B) and (C) violate the probability axiom [0, 1], Option (D) ('More than one of the above') is correct.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.en: A cycle is sold at a gain of 16%. Had it been sold for ₹100 more, the gain would have been 20%. The cost price of the cycle is
questions.hi: एक साइकिल 16% लाभ पर बेची जाती है। यदि इसे ₹100 अधिक पर बेचा जाता, तो 20% का लाभ होता। साइकिल का क्रय मूल्य है
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The difference between 20% gain and 16% gain is 4% of Cost Price (CP). 4% of CP = ₹100 -> CP = (100 / 4) * 100 = ₹2,500.
questions.tip: Percentage difference shortcut: Difference in Profit % = Price difference. (20% - 16%) = 4% -> 100% = 25 * 100 = 2500.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The difference between 20% gain and 16% gain is 4% of Cost Price (CP). 4% of CP = ₹100 -> CP = (100 / 4) * 100 = ₹2,500.

questions.en: At what rate of simple interest, a certain sum of money becomes its seven times in 24 years?
questions.hi: साधारण ब्याज की किस दर से कोई धनराशि 24 वर्षों में अपनी 7 गुनी हो जाएगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: If principal is P, amount is 7P; Simple Interest SI = 6P. Formula: SI = (P * R * T) / 100 -> 6P = (P * R * 24) / 100 -> R = (6 * 100) / 24 = 25% per annum.
questions.tip: Direct formula for n-times: Rate R = ((n - 1) * 100) / T = ((7 - 1) * 100) / 24 = 600 / 24 = 25%.

questions.en: If the perimeter of a semi-circular protractor is 36 cm, what is its radius? (Take pi = 22/7)(
questions.hi: यदि एक अर्धवृत्ताकार चांदे का परिमाप 36 सेमी है, तो इसकी त्रिज्या क्या होगी? (pi = 22/7 लें))
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Perimeter of semi-circle = pi*r + 2r = r(pi + 2) = r(22/7 + 2) = r(36/7). Given perimeter = 36 cm: r * (36/7) = 36 => r = 7 cm.
questions.tip: Common error: Do not use pi*r alone. The perimeter of a semi-circle includes its straight diameter boundary: P = r(pi + 2).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.tip_hi: Common error: Do not use pi*r alone. The perimeter of a semi-circle includes its straight diameter boundary: P = r(pi + 2).

questions.en: A train 150 metres long crosses a telegraph pole in 15 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.hi: 150 मीटर लंबी एक रेलगाड़ी एक टेलीग्राफ खंभे को 15 सेकंड में पार करती है। रेलगाड़ी की गति किमी/घंटा में क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Speed = Distance / Time = 150 m / 15 s = 10 m/s. Converting to km/h: 10 * (18/5) = 36 km/h.
questions.tip: Conversion factor: m/s to km/h = multiply by 18/5; km/h to m/s = multiply by 5/18.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Speed = Distance / Time = 150 m / 15 s = 10 m/s. Converting to किमी/h: 10 * (18/5) = 36 किमी/h.
questions.tip_hi: Conversion factor: m/s to किमी/h = multiply by 18/5; किमी/h to m/s = multiply by 5/18.

questions.en: What is the sum of the interior angles of a regular hexagon?(
questions.hi: एक सम-षट्भुज (regular hexagon) के अंतःकोणों का योग कितना होता है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Formula for sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon = (n - 2) * 180 degrees. For a hexagon (n = 6): (6 - 2) * 180 = 4 * 180 = 720 degrees.
questions.tip: Each interior angle of a regular hexagon = 720 / 6 = 120 degrees.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Formula for sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon = (n - 2) * 180 डिग्री. For a hexagon (n = 6): (6 - 2) * 180 = 4 * 180 = 720 डिग्री.

questions.hi: यदि a : b = 2 : 3 तथा b : c = 4 : 5 हो, तो मिश्रित अनुपात a : b : c होगा
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Equalize the common term b: a:b = 2*4 : 3*4 = 8:12, and b:c = 4*3 : 5*3 = 12:15. Hence, a:b:c = 8:12:15.
questions.tip: Standard ratio combination: a:b:c = (2*4) : (3*4) : (3*5) = 8 : 12 : 15.
